"Gir" |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[4 ABY]], [[Endor]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}}, which includes GR-792's [[death]] on [[Endor]], to [[4 ABY]]. |species=[[Human]]''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]'' establishes that the [[stormtrooper]]s of the [[Galactic Empire]] were all [[human]]s. |gender= |pronouns=He/him{{StoryCite|story=Ending Protocol|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi}} |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin=Pale |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Stormtrooper Corps]] **[[Tempest Force]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Freeze! Don't move!|GR-792 to Leia Organa and Han Solo|{{Film|VI}}}} '''GR-792''', nicknamed "'''Gir'''," was a [[stormtrooper]] who patrolled the [[forest]] [[moon]] [[Endor]] along with [[RZ-440]]. During the [[Battle of Endor]], GR-792 managed to fire a shot at the [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], but missed and hit her in the shoulder after RZ-440 kicked him in the leg on accident. The two troopers approached Organa and the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]], with GR-792 ordering them to put their hands up, but GR-792 was shot by Organa and [[Death|killed]]. {{Char-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{Film|VI}} {{1st}} *{{StoryCite|story=Ending Protocol|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi|audiobook=1}} {{1stID|GR-792}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |nl=GR-792 |pl=GR-792 }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Tempest Force members]]
